messages.subject: Santander UK Resourcing | Director-Level Corporate Affairs, ESG & Regulatory Executive
messages.body:
Dear Santander UK Resourcing Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior leadership opportunities where corporate affairs, government and regulatory relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and strategic partnerships intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. This combination gives me a strong perspective on institutional trust, governance, regulatory engagement, sustainability and executive-level stakeholder management.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Regulatory Strategy and related leadership functions. I am internationally mobile and open to UK opportunities with employer-supported work authorization where required.

I have attached a Santander UK-tailored executive CV for review and future matching. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates, or referral to the appropriate senior recruiter within the People & Culture organisation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
